title: Return a redirect
summary: Phoenix: Return a redirect. Inspect the initial 302 response.
introduction: redirect sends a location. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Return a redirect
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/start", LessonController, :start
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def start(conn, _params), do: redirect(conn, to: "/hello")
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Welcome")
end

blocks.text: redirect sets an internal location. The browser follows it to the hello action.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use an internal path for this example, not an unchecked outside destination.
